propositions: Operator-attested evidence currently lacks provenance context (environment, principal, privilege, instrument) allowing measurements taken in wrong environments or under broader privilege than production to pass as valid attestations.

The existing evidence contract demands attestation-event provenance (change id / vote / timestamp) but nothing about measurement provenance, creating an escape where cached measurements from account 579718921998/us-east-2 were recorded as settled fact for work targeting 896586841071/us-east-1 without detection.

Evidence generated under broader privilege (bedrock:* covering bedrock:InvokeModel) cannot fail in ways production-scoped grants would, rendering success non-informative and structurally unable to surface the planned scoped-grant failure.

Simulations and static analysis produce structurally different evidence than live calls for authorization claims (simulator answers 'is action named?' not 'which action does API check?'), but the current contract cannot distinguish them.

Forcing measurement provenance into the record as text allows repo-grounded machinery to find contradictions (declared environment vs IaC backend account) without re-running world measurements or re-auditing credentials.
